evidence_quote: This retrospective study explored the associations of plasma homocysteine (Hcy), cysteine (Cys) and methionine (Met) levels with 90-day prognosis in intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) patients and evaluated their predictive value for ICH prognosis.
rationale: The study directly addresses prognostic biomarkers for intracerebral hemorrhage, aligning with the profile’s interests in stroke and biomarkers for neurological disorders.
